{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
set -eo pipefail

export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
export WANDB_MODE=offline
export WANDB_CONSOLE=off
export WANDB_DIR=/root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/wandb_logs/
export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1

trap 'echo "INTERRUPTED at $(date), cleaning up..."; kill 0; exit 1' INT TERM

DATA_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/full_m2_training_data"
OUT_BASE="/root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/checkpoints/m2_full_qwen"
LOG_DIR="/root/runs/m2_full_qwen"
MODEL="/root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/models/Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-3B"
TRAIN_SCRIPT="/root/structfuse-context/training/train.py"

STRATEGIES=("random" "embedding_distance" "dataflow_aware")
SEEDS=(43 44)

mkdir -p "${LOG_DIR}" "${OUT_BASE}"

TOTAL_RUNS=9
RUN_NUM=0

for STRATEGY in "${STRATEGIES[@]}"; do
    for SEED in "${SEEDS[@]}"; do
        RUN_NUM=$((RUN_NUM + 1))
        TAG="${STRATEGY}_s${SEED}"
        LOG_FILE="${LOG_DIR}/${TAG}.log"

        echo "=========================================="
        echo "[${RUN_NUM}/${TOTAL_RUNS}] Starting: ${TAG} at $(date)"
        echo "=========================================="

        TRAIN_FILE="${DATA_DIR}/train_${STRATEGY}_s${SEED}.jsonl"
        VAL_FILE="${DATA_DIR}/val_${STRATEGY}_s${SEED}.jsonl"
        OUT_DIR="${OUT_BASE}/${TAG}"

        if [ ! -f "${TRAIN_FILE}" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: Train file not found: ${TRAIN_FILE}"
            exit 1
        fi
        if [ ! -f "${VAL_FILE}" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: Val file not found: ${VAL_FILE}"
            exit 1
        fi

        EXTRA_ARGS=""
        if [ "${STRATEGY}" = "dataflow_aware" ]; then
            EXTRA_ARGS="--dataflow-graph-file ${DATA_DIR}/dataflow_graph.json"
        fi

        python "${TRAIN_SCRIPT}" \
            --model-name "${MODEL}" \
            --train-file "${TRAIN_FILE}" \
            --val-file "${VAL_FILE}" \
            --output-dir "${OUT_DIR}" \
            --hard-negative-strategy "${STRATEGY}" \
            --learning-rate 2e-5 \
            --temperature 0.07 \
            --batch-size 8 \
            --num-epochs 2 \
            --num-negatives 7 \
            --hard-negative-ratio 0.5 \
            --use-lora \
            --gradient-checkpointing \
            --max-seq-length 2048 \
            --seed "${SEED}" \
            --eval-steps 500 \
            --save-steps 1000 \
            --wandb-project structfuse \
            --wandb-run-name "m2_full_${TAG}" \
            --early-stopping-patience 2 \
            ${EXTRA_ARGS} \
            2>&1 | tee "${LOG_FILE}"

        TRAIN_EXIT=$?
        if [ ${TRAIN_EXIT} -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "ERROR: ${TAG} failed with exit code ${TRAIN_EXIT}"
            echo "Last 20 lines of log:"
            tail -20 "${LOG_FILE}"
            exit ${TRAIN_EXIT}
        fi

        echo "[${RUN_NUM}/${TOTAL_RUNS}] Completed: ${TAG} at $(date)"

        # Print final eval metrics from log
        grep -E "\[Final eval\]|\[eval@" "${LOG_FILE}" | tail -3

        # Print checkpoint summary
        if [ -f "${OUT_DIR}/best_by_val_loss/training_config.json" ]; then
            echo "  best_by_val_loss checkpoint saved"
        fi
        if [ -f "${OUT_DIR}/best_by_recall_at_1/training_config.json" ]; then
            echo "  best_by_recall_at_1 checkpoint saved"
        fi

        # Clean intermediate checkpoints to save disk
        find "${OUT_DIR}" -maxdepth 1 -name "checkpoint-*" -type d -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true

        echo ""
    done
done

# -- BM25 s42: 2 epochs, D050 unified regime (appended after loop) --
RUN_NUM=$((RUN_NUM + 1))
TAG="bm25_s42"
LOG_FILE="${LOG_DIR}/${TAG}.log"

echo "=========================================="
echo "[${RUN_NUM}/7] Starting: ${TAG} at $(date)"
echo "=========================================="

TRAIN_FILE="${DATA_DIR}/train_bm25_s42.jsonl"
VAL_FILE="${DATA_DIR}/val_bm25_s42.jsonl"
OUT_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/full_m2_outputs/bm25_s42"

if [ ! -f "${TRAIN_FILE}" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: Train file not found: ${TRAIN_FILE}"
    exit 1
fi
if [ ! -f "${VAL_FILE}" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: Val file not found: ${VAL_FILE}"
    exit 1
fi

mkdir -p "${OUT_DIR}"

python "${TRAIN_SCRIPT}" \
    --model-name "${MODEL}" \
    --train-file "${TRAIN_FILE}" \
    --val-file "${VAL_FILE}" \
    --output-dir "${OUT_DIR}" \
    --hard-negative-strategy "bm25" \
    --learning-rate 2e-5 \
    --temperature 0.07 \
    --batch-size 8 \
    --num-epochs 2 \
    --num-negatives 7 \
    --hard-negative-ratio 0.5 \
    --use-lora \
    --gradient-checkpointing \
    --max-seq-length 2048 \
    --seed 42 \
    --eval-steps 500 \
    --save-steps 1000 \
    --wandb-project structfuse \
    --wandb-run-name "m2_full_bm25_s42" \
    --early-stopping-patience 2 \
    2>&1 | tee "${LOG_FILE}"

TRAIN_EXIT=$?
if [ ${TRAIN_EXIT} -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "ERROR: ${TAG} failed with exit code ${TRAIN_EXIT}"
    echo "Last 20 lines of log:"
    tail -20 "${LOG_FILE}"
    exit ${TRAIN_EXIT}
fi

echo "[${RUN_NUM}/7] Completed: ${TAG} at $(date)"

grep -E "\[Final eval\]|\[eval@" "${LOG_FILE}" | tail -3

if [ -f "${OUT_DIR}/best_by_val_loss/training_config.json" ]; then
    echo "  best_by_val_loss checkpoint saved"
fi
if [ -f "${OUT_DIR}/best_by_recall_at_1/training_config.json" ]; then
    echo "  best_by_recall_at_1 checkpoint saved"
fi

find "${OUT_DIR}" -maxdepth 1 -name "checkpoint-*" -type d -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true

echo ""


echo "=========================================="
echo "ALL 7 RUNS COMPLETED at $(date)"
echo "=========================================="

set -e

  local ckpt_dir="$1"
  local out_name="$2"
  local LOG="${RESULTS_DIR}/${out_name}.log"

  if [ -f "${RESULTS_DIR}/${out_name}.json" ] && grep -q "recall@1" "${RESULTS_DIR}/${out_name}.json"; then
    echo "SKIP $out_name: already evaluated"
    return
  fi

  echo "=== Evaluating $out_name (ckpt: $ckpt_dir, pool_size=$POOL_SIZE) ==="
  python scripts/eval_p2b_pooled.py \
    --ckpt-dir "$ckpt_dir" \
    --model-name "$MODEL" \
    --pool-size $POOL_SIZE \
    --device cuda:0 \
    2>&1 | tee "$LOG"

  python3 -c "
import re, json
with open('$LOG') as f:
    text = f.read()
m = re.search(r'Results:\s*(\{.*\})', text, re.DOTALL)
if m:
    metrics = json.loads(m.group(1))
    metrics['run'] = '$out_name'
    metrics['ckpt_dir'] = '$ckpt_dir'
    with open('${RESULTS_DIR}/${out_name}.json', 'w') as out:
        json.dump(metrics, out, indent=2)
    print(f'Saved: ${RESULTS_DIR}/${out_name}.json')
else:
    print('WARNING: could not parse metrics from log')
"

      echo "SKIP ${RUN_NAME}_final: no model.pt"

    eval_checkpoint "$FINAL_CKPT" "${RUN_NAME}_final"

    BEST_CKPT="${RUN_DIR}/best"

with open('${RESULTS_DIR}/${RUN_NAME}_best.json') as f:

d['run'] = '${RUN_NAME}_best'

with open('${RESULTS_DIR}/${RUN_NAME}_best.json', 'w') as f:

{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
set -e
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=4

cd /root/structfuse

CKPT_BASE="/root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/checkpoints"
RESULTS_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/eval_results"
MODEL="/root/structfuse-context/models/Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-3B"
mkdir -p $RESULTS_DIR

find_best_ckpt() {
  local run_dir="$1"
  local best_ckpt=""
  local best_step=0

  # Strategy 1: trainer_state.json → lowest val_loss
  local has_trainer_state=false
  local best_val_loss="999"
  for ckpt_dir in "$run_dir"/checkpoint-*/; do
    [ -d "$ckpt_dir" ] || continue
    if [ -f "$ckpt_dir/trainer_state.json" ]; then
      has_trainer_state=true
      val_loss=$(python3 -c "
import json, sys
try:
    s = json.load(open('${ckpt_dir}/trainer_state.json'))
    losses = [l['eval_loss'] for l in s['log_history'] if 'eval_loss' in l]
    if losses:
        print(min(losses))
    else:
        print('none')
except Exception:
    print('none')
" 2>/dev/null)
      if [ "$val_loss" != "none" ] && [ -n "$val_loss" ]; then
        is_better=$(python3 -c "print('yes' if float('${val_loss}') < float('${best_val_loss}') else 'no')" 2>/dev/null)
        if [ "$is_better" = "yes" ]; then
          best_val_loss="$val_loss"
          best_ckpt="$ckpt_dir"
        fi
      fi
    fi
  done
  if [ "$has_trainer_state" = true ] && [ -n "$best_ckpt" ]; then
    echo "$best_ckpt"
    return
  fi

  # Strategy 2: no trainer_state → pick highest-numbered checkpoint-N
  for ckpt_dir in "$run_dir"/checkpoint-*/; do
    [ -d "$ckpt_dir" ] || continue
    [ -f "$ckpt_dir/model.pt" ] || continue
    step=$(basename "$ckpt_dir" | sed 's/checkpoint-//')
    if [ "$step" -gt "$best_step" ] 2>/dev/null; then
      best_step=$step
      best_ckpt="$ckpt_dir"
    fi
  done
  echo "$best_ckpt"
}

eval_checkpoint() {
  local ckpt_dir="$1"
  local out_name="$2"

  local LOG="${RESULTS_DIR}/${out_name}_eval.log"
  if [ -f "$LOG" ] && grep -q "recall@1" "$LOG"; then
    echo "SKIP $out_name: already evaluated"
    return
  fi

  echo "=== Evaluating $out_name (ckpt: $ckpt_dir) ==="
  python scripts/eval_p2b.py \
    --ckpt-dir "$ckpt_dir" \
    --model-name "$MODEL" \
    --device cuda:0 \
    2>&1 | tee "$LOG"

  python3 -c "
import re, json
with open('$LOG') as f:
    text = f.read()
m = re.search(r'Results:\s*(\{.*\})', text, re.DOTALL)
if m:
    metrics = json.loads(m.group(1))
    metrics['run'] = '$out_name'
    metrics['ckpt_dir'] = '$ckpt_dir'
    with open('${RESULTS_DIR}/${out_name}_eval.json', 'w') as out:
        json.dump(metrics, out, indent=2)
    print(f'Saved: ${RESULTS_DIR}/${out_name}_eval.json')
else:
    print('WARNING: could not parse metrics from log')
"
}

for SEED in 42 123 456; do
  for STRATEGY in random embedding_distance dataflow_aware; do
    RUN_NAME="p2b_${STRATEGY}_s${SEED}"
    RUN_DIR="${CKPT_BASE}/${RUN_NAME}"

    if [ ! -d "$RUN_DIR" ]; then
      echo "SKIP $RUN_NAME: directory not found"
      continue
    fi

    # --- Final checkpoint ---
    FINAL_CKPT="${RUN_DIR}/final"
    if [ ! -f "$FINAL_CKPT/model.pt" ]; then
      FINAL_CKPT="$RUN_DIR"
      if [ ! -f "$FINAL_CKPT/model.pt" ]; then
        echo "SKIP $RUN_NAME: no final model.pt found"
        continue
      fi
    fi
    eval_checkpoint "$FINAL_CKPT" "${RUN_NAME}_final"

    # --- Best checkpoint ---
    BEST_CKPT=$(find_best_ckpt "$RUN_DIR")
    if [ -n "$BEST_CKPT" ] && [ "$BEST_CKPT" != "$FINAL_CKPT" ] && [ "$BEST_CKPT" != "$FINAL_CKPT/" ]; then
      eval_checkpoint "$BEST_CKPT" "${RUN_NAME}_best"
    else
      echo "INFO $RUN_NAME: best == final (no separate intermediate checkpoint), symlink result"
      if [ -f "${RESULTS_DIR}/${RUN_NAME}_final_eval.json" ]; then
        cp "${RESULTS_DIR}/${RUN_NAME}_final_eval.json" "${RESULTS_DIR}/${RUN_NAME}_best_eval.json"
        python3 -c "
import json
with open('${RESULTS_DIR}/${RUN_NAME}_best_eval.json') as f:
    d = json.load(f)
d['run'] = '${RUN_NAME}_best'
d['note'] = 'same as final (no intermediate checkpoints found)'
with open('${RESULTS_DIR}/${RUN_NAME}_best_eval.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(d, f, indent=2)
"
      fi
    fi
  done
done

echo ""
echo "=== All evaluations complete ==="
echo ""

# Aggregate results
python3 -c "
import json, glob, os

results = []
for f in sorted(glob.glob('${RESULTS_DIR}/*_eval.json')):
    name = os.path.basename(f).replace('_eval.json', '')
    with open(f) as fp:
        data = json.load(fp)
    data['run'] = name
    results.append(data)

if not results:
    print('No results found.')
else:
    print('| Run | Recall@1 | Recall@5 | Recall@10 | Total | Checkpoint |')
    print('|-----|----------|----------|-----------|-------|------------|')
    for r in results:
        ckpt = r.get('ckpt_dir', 'N/A')
        note = r.get('note', '')
        suffix = f' ({note})' if note else ''
        r1 = r.get('recall@1', 'N/A')
        r5 = r.get('recall@5', 'N/A')
        r10 = r.get('recall@10', 'N/A')
        fmt = lambda v: f'{v:.4f}' if isinstance(v, float) else str(v)
        print(f'| {r[\"run\"]} | {fmt(r1)} | {fmt(r5)} | {fmt(r10)} | {r.get(\"total\", \"N/A\")} | {os.path.basename(ckpt.rstrip(\"/\"))}{suffix} |')
"

The ROADMAP values represent the best R@1 achieved across all evaluation steps for each model checkpoint. The SSH values showing discrepancy are actually the final evaluation metrics at early stopping, not the best checkpoint performance — that's why they differ from the ROADMAP values.

Now I'm compiling the complete evaluation metrics table for random_s42 across the in-training evaluations to see where the best performance occurred. Looking at s43's full results, it achieved the best validation loss at step 500 with R@5 of 0.9699, then degraded before early stopping at 1500. Meanwhile s44 started even stronger with the lowest val_loss of 0.4252 and highest R@1 of 0.6009 at step 500, though the metrics began declining afterward. Looking at the evaluation metrics for embedding_distance_s44, the best validation loss came at step 1000 with 0.4341, though the model achieved its highest R@1 score of 0.5942 earlier at step 500. Performance degraded after step 1000, with the final evaluation showing val_loss=0.5123. Now checking the dataflow_aware_s43 results, which shows promising metrics at the 500-step checkpoint with val_loss=0.4617 and R@5=0.9728.

I'm noticing that all these evaluation numbers are from in-training validation using a pool size of 8 (one positive plus seven negatives), so there aren't any results yet with larger pool sizes like 20 or 50 for the m2_full_qwen experiments. The consistent R@10=1.0 across all runs confirms this smaller pool setup, since finding the positive sample in the top 10 becomes trivial with only 8 total candidates.

The ROADMAP is tracking the best R@1 achieved across all evaluation checkpoints, whereas the final evaluation line shows the model state at the early stopping point—these aren't necessarily the same. The best checkpoint by recall is the one that would actually get deployed, so I need to be clear about which metric the user should reference.
